stem.text: Which force–extension graph shows plastic deformation of a sample of material?

A.alt: Force against extension graph; the line rises from the origin and is marked with arrows showing loading and unloading.

B.alt: Force against extension graph; a curve rises from the origin with arrows showing loading and unloading.

C.alt: Force against extension graph; two curves start at the origin, with arrows showing loading and unloading.

D.alt: Force against extension graph; a loading curve and a parallel unloading curve, with arrows showing direction.
